newsitem.title: USA: EG&G Inc wins five-year U.S. Navy contract.
newsitem.headline: EG&G Inc wins five-year U.S. Navy contract.

text.p: EG&G Inc said the U.S. Navy awarded a five-year, $106.5 million support contract to its EG&G Washington Analytical Services Center Inc unit, for engineering and technical services.
The contract calls for the Washington Analytical Services Center to provide engineering and technical services to support the Navy's new attack submarine program.
The program is developing a new class of advanced submarine. The contract would cover the first four submarines to be introduced in this class, the company said.

EG&G said it would support submarine and combat system design, engineering, production, test and life cycle activities -- all operations other than nuclear power propulsion. It would also provide program management services.
